proposals.observation: 4 sessions landed on the quiz intro in 48h; 0 started, 0 completed. Every visitor stopped at intro_load — the call-to-action copy or button is not compelling enough to earn a single click. proposals.proposal: Rewrite the quiz intro headline and subheading to speak directly to the ICP's core tension — earning well but not building — and replace any vague 'find out your money type' framing with a specific, grounded promise about what the quiz reveals. Also change the button label from a generic verb to a phrase that signals the first step of honest self-inquiry rather than a quiz game.

proposals.observation: The 'Daily Blog Post' GitHub Actions workflow failed at 06:31 on 2026-05-14. The content queue shows only 1 post queued against 27 published, meaning the pipeline is nearly empty. If the workflow continues to fail, the blog goes dark — reducing organic discovery and giving the automations nothing new to link to.
proposals.proposal: Add a fallback error-notification step to the Daily Blog Post workflow that posts a single line to a monitoring file when the job fails, so Joel gets a visible signal in the repo without touching the workflow file itself. Since .github/workflows/* is blocked, instead patch the workflow's downstream output file that records last-successful-run so the gap is immediately visible on the dashboard and Joel can manually trigger or investigate.
proposals.impact: Surfaces two silent pipeline failures so Joel can unblock content before the queue empties

proposals.observation: The Money Vigilance automation has the highest open rate of the three sequences at 50% (4/8), yet it has been sent to the fewest subscribers — only 8, roughly half the volume of Avoidance (15) and Worship (16). This suggests the quiz result that routes people into Vigilance is under-represented, either because fewer people reach that result or because the routing logic is narrow. The sequence itself is clearly resonating when it lands.
proposals.proposal: Add a dedicated nurture email to the Money Vigilance sequence that deepens the core theme — the steady, watchful earner who tracks everything but still feels financially unsafe — using a short narrative scenario the ICP will recognise, with a soft CTA toward a discovery call. This capitalises on the proven 50% open rate while the sequence is warm, without touching any pricing or checkout logic.

You probably know your numbers.

Not roughly — properly. You've checked the account this week. Maybe more than once.

And still, somewhere underneath the tracking, there's a low hum that doesn't go away. A sense that it's not quite enough, or not quite safe, even when the logic says otherwise.

That's not a gap in your financial knowledge. It's the story beneath the money — the one that formed long before you had a salary.

Most people in your position try to solve it with more information. Another tracker. A better system. A higher savings rate.

The numbers get tidier. The hum stays.

If you're at the point where you want to look honestly at what's actually driving that — not fix it with a spreadsheet, but do the work underneath — a discovery call is the right next step.

There's no pitch on the call. It's a grounded conversation about what's keeping the pattern in place.

[Book a discovery call →]

Joel
proposals.impact: Deepens the highest-performing sequence while it has momentum, increasing call bookings from a warm segment
